main_body: A round leafy bush/canopy filling the whole tile area, drawn as a clump of greens with a few small brown twig spots, no trunk visible
top_band: none; the column reads as leaf clumps from the top row to the bottom, with no distinct top band and front face
evidence: The object is a roundish mass of foliage seen almost from above, with no trunk or front face below a canopy top. Light greens sit at the top and darker greens toward the bottom, but this is leaf-clump shading and not a separate horizontal top surface over a vertical front. There is no front edge line, eave shadow or recessed front. It reads as a flat top-down plan of a bush, so it fails the 3/4 contract strictly.

style.evidence: The canopy uses about 5 greens (deep teal-green, dark, mid, light, bright lime) in leaf clumps with no flat areas. The dark outline pixels lean teal-green, so they follow the material tone and are not near-black. Compared with the reference trees, it has no trunk, branches or shadowed underside volume, and its tiles are somewhat less varied than the reference canopies. It is still a competent foliage texture and sits comfortably next to the reference canopies.
